annotations.text: Provides lifecycle, maintenance, degraded, and return indications. Consumes coordinationFrame.mode. No start or power authority is implied.
Two-field atomic outcome: mode is ControllerMode; parkingBrake is ParkingBrakeCommand. The command is a request, not physical achievement.
Consumes coordinationFrame.parkingBrake. Apply and Release are requests. No achievement feedback is modeled.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 01-05. INT-01 Root lifecycle → Lifecycle Epoch. INT-02 Root maintenance → Maintenance Epoch. INT-03 Root degraded → Degradation Epoch. INT-04 Root return → Return Epoch. INT-05 Lifecycle Epoch → Conflict Classification.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 06-09. INT-06 Maintenance Epoch → Conflict Classification. INT-07 Degradation Epoch → Conflict Classification. INT-08 Return Epoch → Conflict Classification. INT-09 Conflict Classification → Indication Priority.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 10-14. INT-10 Lifecycle Epoch → Indication Priority. INT-11 Maintenance Epoch → Indication Priority. INT-12 Degradation Epoch → Indication Priority. INT-13 Return Epoch → Indication Priority. INT-14 Indication Priority → Operating Demand.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 15-18. INT-15 Indication Priority → Maintenance Session. INT-16 Maintenance Epoch → Maintenance Session. INT-17 Degradation Epoch → Degraded Episode. INT-18 Conflict Classification → Recovery Eligibility.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 19-23. INT-19 Indication Priority → Recovery Eligibility. INT-20 Degradation Epoch → Recovery Eligibility. INT-21 Return Epoch → Recovery Eligibility. INT-22 Degraded Episode → Recovery Eligibility. INT-23 Recovery Eligibility → Degraded Episode.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 24-27. INT-24 Recovery Eligibility → Operating Demand. INT-25 Operating Demand → Mode Transition. INT-26 Maintenance Session → Mode Transition. INT-27 Degraded Episode → Mode Transition.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 28-31. INT-28 Indication Priority → Degraded Episode. INT-29 Recovery Eligibility → Mode Transition. INT-30 Maintenance Session → Parking-Brake Demand. INT-31 Degraded Episode → Parking-Brake Demand.

SEMANTIC DIRECTIONS 32-35. INT-32 Indication Priority → Parking-Brake Demand. INT-33 Mode Transition → Outcome Coherence. INT-34 Parking-Brake Demand → Outcome Coherence. INT-35 Outcome Coherence → Root coordinationFrame.

GENERATED SUPPORT — NO SEMANTIC CREDIT. support01-support04 delegate the four inputs from root to Process for INT-01..INT-04. support05 delegates INT-35 from Process to root. Exact semantic count is 35, not 40 routed edges.
